about_the_game:
Add a demonic swordswoman, uniform-wearing shopkeeper, and upbeat healer to your party with the Another World Heroine Generator 7 for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft expands their MZ generator collection once more, with 40 new generator parts to add even more appearances to your heroines and NPCs! Give your military base a variety of uniforms so it’s easier on your players to spot who they need to talk to next, and upgrade your party members’ battle outfits with flowing fabric or lightweight armor. Let your characters have haircuts that reflect their personalities, and give each of your youthful heroines their own shining eyes with a bright spark of positivity that can’t be extinguished even by the demon lord!

2 AccB, 3 Beast Ear horns, 20 Clothing, 5 Eye, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts offer up stylish new options for your female characters. Turn your human heroine into a demon with horns coming out of her forehead at the start of your game, and let your players visually know when it’s time to explore a dungeon by swapping out her plain uniform with a skirt for a kimono-inspired dress with long flowing sleeves. Or show when she’s had a major life change by having her cut her long straight hair into a short bob with this pack’s rear hair options. If your heroines have been needing a new wardrobe or you just want to add some cool new horns to your demon villagers, check out the Another World Heroine Generator 7 for MZ pack!


Contents:

・5 Beast Ears
・20 Clothing
・Eyes: 5
・Front Hair: 5
・Rear Hair: 5

＊An optimized base body is included in each folder in this pack, so please save the default base body in a separate local folder, and then store the optimized base body in each generator folder for use.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
